_comment: Which INTERACTIVE POINT of each aircraft model is which door. 'match' is text looked for in the simulator title (case does not matter), 'exclude' is text that rules a title out, 'doors' is role -> interactive point index; the exit event takes index + 1. Roles starting with 'cargo' are holds, everything else is a passenger or service door. A model with no entry here has its doors left alone, which is right for FSLTL's FAIB models: they have no door animation at all. Add an entry with scripts/scan_doors.py, which sets 'verified' once the indices have been watched.

A321 Asobo.measured_on: the flyable A321, simulator title "A321" (scan_portes.py --title "A321"); not the PassiveAircraft A321 CEO/NEO, on which these points toggle but no door moves
